mapper.select: select product_seq as productSeq, product_name as productName, product_code as productCode from micro_product where product_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') or product_code = #{name} or #{name} like concat('%', product_name, '%') or #{name} like concat('%', product_code, '%') order by (product_name = #{name} or product_code = #{name}) desc, length(product_name) desc limit 5

select process_seq as processSeq, process_name as processName, process_code as processCode from micro_process_common where process_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') or process_code = #{name} or #{name} like concat('%', process_name, '%') or #{name} like concat('%', process_code, '%') order by (process_name = #{name} or process_code = #{name}) desc, length(process_name) desc limit 5

select id as userId, nick_name as nickName, user_name as userName from micro_user where nick_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') or user_name = #{name} or phonenumber = #{name} or #{name} like concat('%', nick_name, '%') order by (nick_name = #{name} or user_name = #{name}) desc, length(nick_name) desc limit 5

choose.when: select product_name as name, product_code as code from micro_product where tenant_code = #{tenantCode} order by product_code limit 10
select process_name as name, process_code as code from micro_process_common where tenant_code = #{tenantCode} order by process_code limit 10
select nick_name as name, user_name as code from micro_user where tenant_code = #{tenantCode} order by user_name limit 10
